D4BCAB9B74C241A89153913A1ACB8AF3.description: Gather information through sight, hearing, taste, smell, and touch.

D5B2C6D9C3D6437AB5282CC133FB1DEE.description:
Ask questions to find out
more about the natural
world.

D671773819244654AF961832AA688781.description:
Notice, describe, and attempt to explain
properties of materials and changes in substances (metal railing is hot because the sun
shines on it; ice melts when it gets warmer).

D7071B9CD71340448A6DB4AD87EA5E09.description:
Explore objects, tools, and materials systematically to learn about their properties (weigh an object, observe
something from the top of the
object to the bottom).

D7CEF299B81946E5AB2198FBDB69339B.description:
Imitate behaviors they
have seen in the past or
in other places.

D805093AA51948459A010DE578629544.description: Use simple tools to manipulate and explore objects and materials, with guidance and support (containers for pouring, sand mold, magnifying glass)

DC1D4B2C464F457DBB1D8636C5122EEC.description:
Use language to identify pretend or fantasy situations (say, “Let’s
pretend we’re going on
a trip.” “That’s a pretend
story.”).

DC6AD9F413434245854BE0813BF5EB9E.description:
Children recognize that they are members of different groups (e.g., family, preschool class,
cultural group).

DE1B57F39FCB4D4EBDE5FC13C4386908.description:
Choose to participate and
express themselves through a
variety of creative experiences,
such as art, music, movement,
dance, and dramatic play.

DFFCAD1429704863B3F7BA2CFEE07D97.description:
Notice and talk about
weather conditions.

E0D8CA13A03D4CDBAF58AB53C424A4AA.description: Participate in, describe and ask questions about art, music, dance, drama, or other aesthetic experiences (describe dancers spinning round and round; talk about colors in a painting).

E12C497B02C94AB7AA6C0D23205FE110.description: Participate in, describe and ask questions about art, music, dance, drama, or other aesthetic experiences (describe dancers spinning round and round; talk about colors in a painting).

E1D2F513713A4FA8B37E936EA10CB378.description: Express pleasure in different forms of art (express preferences, choose to look at book of photographs or listen to music again).

E3E36B725FAC4278B6640F6458250B1E.description:
Notice and describe
characteristics of plants and
animals, such as appearance,
similarities, differences,
behavior, and habitat.

E4E8537329604376A942F4EEF05357F6.description:
With prompting and support,
participate as a member
of a democratic classroom
community (vote for name of
class pet, wait turn to paint when
easels are full).

E6977D27627442D3B95100043FE3A83C.description:
Notice and describe weather conditions,
position of the sun and moon at different
times, and seasonal changes.

E8A828D1390242CEB1862DCEE1C16B8F.description:
Choose objects to
represent something
else with similar
features during play
(block for cell
phone, large sheet
for tent).

E993A242F3494FD2B103E325FCC2EA6E.description: Show wonder or fascination with objects, activities, or experiences (gaze at an object, become quiet or vocal when they hear lullabies, show bodily excitement when they hear music).

EE54F1AEC15D4F3B8D28A22B4718D9E1.description:
Notice changes
in materials
when mixing and
manipulating
(paint, PlayDoh®, food
ingredients).

EE89F4633D264A59B24B9F9947480ACF.description:
Describe characteristics of
the places where they live and
play (say,“My house is big and there are trees in my yard.” “The playground has swings and a sandbox.”).

F41B91212B064694975E8FC83041E2B3.description:
Show awareness
of similarities and
differences among
people and families
during play.

F695A4B564914BD6ADEE029CE0601971.description:
Express ideas and
feelings through
music, movement, and
dance.

F7583175FB9E4ACB9A31A641E04F6094.description:
Seek family
members, siblings,
caregivers, and
teachers for play and
for meeting needs.

F7821E8DE84B4F64ACF142D5D86C2AEE.description:
Plan and complete artistic
creations such as drawings,
paintings, collages, and
sculptures.

FC7B94DB195E4128A351905FAA79B297.description:
Talk about what they
and other people want
or like.

FC960933F82347D39DC972FA1A07EC61.description:
Show awareness of various
patterns of beat, rhythm, and
movement through music and
dance activities.

FCBB94B280A742F9A8FCCE2797A66D40.description:
Make and check predictions through observations and
experimentation, with adult support and guidance.

FDEC3B0BE59F4978B4204F7EB77F5BC5.description:
Recognize the value of
artistic expression and
the role the arts play in
people’s lives.

FED61E9045BE4104841B9926C7B7AA10.description:
Explore objects and
materials physically
to learn about their
properties.
